Author(s): Esther Hänggi and Severin Winkler

This work investigates whether quantum communication protocols allow confidential access to a remote database. It shows that any protocol that does not reveal which item is retrieved allows the user to reconstruct the entire database.


[Phys. Rev. Research 8, L022036] Published Thu May 28, 2026

title: Directional asymmetry in strong-field ionization induced by a terahertz-assisted laser pulse
authors: F. Žgalj, A. S. Jašarević, D. Habibović, and D. B. Milošević
abstract:
Author(s): F. Žgalj, A. S. Jašarević, D. Habibović, and D. B. Milošević

We investigate directional asymmetry in strong-field ionization driven by a few-cycle near-infrared laser pulse assisted by a time-delayed terahertz (THz) pulse.
